mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month reduces the cost of capital for corporations, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of all observations over the last 5 years, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 45% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1250.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1250.0 during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% during monetary tightening cycles compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
